title: Dorset Council: acoustic monitoring in care homes
summary: Dorset plans 184 acoustic and movement sensors to support care. The source reports intended sleep and falls benefits, before outcome evaluation.
account: Dorset plans to install Ally Labs acoustic and movement monitoring in six care homes to detect changes and support nighttime care. The source describes 184 planned sensors, starting installation in January 2025, with outcome reviews at three and six months. No actual falls, sleep, or care outcome is reported.
purpose: Use nighttime sound and movement patterns to support care decisions and detect residents’ needs.
system: Ally Labs acoustic-monitoring sensors and associated application
deployer: Dorset Council on behalf of the Dorset Integrated Care System

ratings.reason: Better sleep and fewer falls are intended. Installation plans and future evaluation do not define an achieved benefit depth.
Improved care planning and staff response are intended, but the source supplies no realized operational result.

ai_role.statement: The planned system uses machine learning to establish resident behavior profiles and alert staff to sounds, movement, or changed patterns. The source precedes outcome evaluation, so AI’s contribution to better sleep, fewer falls, or improved care is not established.

evidence.citation: Local Government Association, AI case-study bank. Council or project account published by LGA. Hosting and editorial curation do not establish independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Dorset Council: acoustic monitoring in care homes

produced_by: The source describes planned installation of 184 sensors across six care homes, with follow-up reviews at three and six months.
The system combines microphones and infrared sensing with an application for care staff.
must_hold: The source does not establish which conditions are necessary to reproduce the reported benefit.

headline: Dorset plans acoustic monitoring in six care homes

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The deployer's report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
